name: E3b_upper_branch
title: Upper-bound branch of the 6T2M cell (PCM, divider, CMOS inverter, match-line pull-down): prospective test of the first-order drift-compensation laws, sky130 PDK mismatch, linear PCM
branch: PCM from SL_hi to node Y; divider nfet from Y to ground, gate = DL; Y drives a CMOS inverter (output Z); Z drives the match-line pull-down. Upper bound = V_DL at which Z reaches the pull-down switching voltage V_sw,pd, i.e. Y = V_Y*, the inverter input at which its output equals V_sw,pd

laws.switching_point: V_Y* replaces V_sw of the lower branch; delta_Y = V_Y*,k - V_Y*,nom comes from the inverter nMOS and pMOS and, divided by the inverter gain, from the pull-down
laws.supply: dx = (G/dG) (r - 1), r = (D - a delta_Y)/(D - delta_Y) (exact form for a linear PCM; E2 used the first-order equivalent ln r)
laws.dac_remap: dx = (G/dG) [eps(aI) - eps(I)], eps(I) = sum_p s_p(I) z_p + lambda(I) delta_Y, at V_DS = V_Y*,nom (E2 law)
laws.sigma_delta_Y: sqrt of the sum of squared central-difference sensitivities of V_Y* to the 12 mismatch parameters (inverter nMOS 4, inverter pMOS 4, pull-down 4)
laws.rms: predicted rms (LSB) = 15 sqrt(mean over theta of E[dx^2]); E[(r - 1)^2] by the trapezoid rule on [-6 sigma, 6 sigma], delta >= 0.95 D dropped
laws.inputs_allowed: nominal and +-1 sigma single-device and single-inverter simulations only (no Monte Carlo)

models.note: tt; nfet_01v8, nfet_01v8_lvt (files identical to the corner subset) and pfet_01v8 (same per-instance mismatch patch)

INV_S.note: skewed (strong nMOS, weak pMOS): V_Y* close to the lower branch's V_sw so that SL_hi stays near SL_lo

INV_M.note: minimum-size devices: higher trip point, larger mismatch

circuit.criterion: V_sw,pd = gate voltage at which the pull-down conducts 100 nA * W/L with V_DS = 1.8 V; V_Y* = inverter input at which the unloaded inverter output equals V_sw,pd
circuit.programming: threshold verify: G_k(theta) = I_div,k(M0(theta)) / (V_SL,nom - V_Y*,k), divider at V_DS = V_Y*,k; no clipping

condition_note: tt, 27 C; the divider geometries are those of E1 P1 (L 0.15), E2 G1 (1/0.5) and E1 P3 (L 4) so that the upper branch can be compared with the lower branch
feasibility_rule: a condition is dropped before the Monte Carlo phase if the nominal bound at G = 30 uS exceeds 1.75 V

mismatch.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed, rng_stream]); then, in this order, standard_normal((n, 4)) for the divider, the pull-down, the inverter nMOS and the inverter pMOS; columns (vth0, toxe, voff, nfactor); fresh draws

settings.y_only: inverter and pull-down only (divider nominal at V_DS = V_Y*,k)

metric: input-referred bound error 15 (x_eff - theta) in LSB, rms over all (instance, theta) pairs; x_eff from the exact inverse of the nominal map (G(x_eff) D = I_0(b) for M0, G(x_eff) a D = I_0(b) for Ma)

checks.C1: nominal full upper branch (PCM resistor, divider, inverter; bound where the inverter output equals V_sw,pd,nom) equals the I-V inversion with V_Y*,nom within 0.05 mV; G in {2.5, 12.5, 22.5} uS, V_SL,nom and V_SL(1 year)
checks.C2: zero mismatch: dac_remap, supply and ideal errors <= 0.001 LSB
checks.C3: ideal node <= 0.001 LSB on all valid pairs
checks.C4: setup check (mismatch hooks active in all four devices): Monte Carlo sigma of V_Y* within +-50 % of the predicted sigma_delta_Y, every condition. The accuracy of the sigma_delta_Y prediction is not a stop rule: it is reported (secondary) and tested through A1, because the supply-node predictions depend on it
checks.C5: invalid pairs <= 1 % per condition, setting, node (none excluded)
checks.C7: nominal V_Y* and nominal divider curve identical in both phases
checks.stop_rule: any failed check stops the run before the criteria are evaluated

criteria.tolerance: a prediction passes if |pred - sim| <= max(0.15 sim, 0.02 LSB)
criteria.A1: pdk, 1 year, dac_remap and supply: at least 90 % of the (condition, node) pairs pass (10 pairs: at most 1 failure)
criteria.A2: pdk, 1 year: in every condition whose predicted gap is >= 20 % of the larger prediction, the predicted better node is the simulated better node
criteria.A3: secondary: div_only (dac_remap) and y_only (dac_remap, supply), 1 year: at least 90 % pass (reported)
criteria.decision: the laws hold for the upper branch if A1 and A2 hold
criteria.secondary: 1 day and 30 days; sigma_delta_Y Monte Carlo versus prediction (relative difference); comparison of sigma_delta_Y with the lower branch's sigma_delta (E2: 22.61 mV predicted); per-theta profiles
